purpose: Verify that students cannot access professor-level quiz creation functions
preconditions: Authenticated user with Student role and no faculty permissions
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Student is blocked from creating a quiz

purpose: Verify professor can only create/manage quizzes for associated courses
preconditions: Professor user associated with course CS101 but not associated with ME201
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Professor cannot manage quizzes for unassigned course

purpose: Verify student can access only quizzes for which they are eligible
preconditions: Student enrolled in CS101, not enrolled in CS999. Published quiz exists for CS999
action_or_input: GET /quizzing/api/quizzes/?mode=student and POST start attempt for CS999 quiz
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Student cannot view or attempt ineligible quiz

purpose: Verify student cannot view quiz results and answers of other students
preconditions: Student A and Student B have completed attempts. Student A authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found: Access to other student's data denied

purpose: Verify professor can create and save a new quiz as a draft
preconditions: Authenticated professor associated with course CS101
action_or_input: Call QuizService.create_quiz with valid parameters and no publish flag
expected_result: Quiz record created in database with status='DRAFT'

purpose: Verify quiz identity fields title, description, and course association are stored
expected_result: Quiz persisted with title='Midterm Quiz', course_code='CS101', description='Comprehensive exam'

purpose: Verify quiz instructions are captured and persisted
action_or_input: QuizService.create_quiz with description containing detailed student instructions
expected_result: Quiz instructions accurately stored in description field

purpose: Verify quiz duration and total marks calculation during creation
action_or_input: QuizService.create_quiz with duration_minutes=45 and question_ids=[Q1.id, Q2.id]
expected_result: Quiz created with duration_minutes=45 and total_marks=15.0

purpose: Verify configuration of passing marks and permitted attempt limits on quiz
expected_result: Quiz stores passing_marks=40.0 and permitted_attempts=2

purpose: Verify quiz details can be edited while in DRAFT status
action_or_input: Update quiz title to 'Updated Midterm Exam' and duration to 60 minutes
expected_result: Quiz record updated with new title and duration

purpose: Verify quiz details cannot be edited once quiz becomes active/published
preconditions: Quiz has status='PUBLISHED' and start_time is in the past
action_or_input: Attempt to edit quiz title and duration of active quiz
expected_result: ConflictError or validation error: Editing active quiz is prohibited

purpose: Verify configuration of quiz start and closing date/time schedule
preconditions: Valid start_time = now + 1 day, end_time = now + 2 days
expected_result: Quiz schedule successfully persisted with correct start_time and end_time

purpose: Verify validation failure when end_time is before or equal to start_time
preconditions: start_time = now + 2 days, end_time = now + 1 day
expected_result: ValueError raised: Invalid quiz schedule: end time must be after start time

purpose: Verify validation failure when duration_minutes is non-positive
expected_result: ValueError raised: duration must be greater than 0

purpose: Verify publishing a draft quiz transitions status to PUBLISHED
preconditions: Draft quiz exists with at least one question
expected_result: Quiz status updated to 'PUBLISHED'

purpose: Verify closing a published quiz transitions status to CLOSED
expected_result: Quiz status updated to 'CLOSED'

purpose: Verify invalid state transition from DRAFT directly to CLOSED is rejected
expected_result: ConflictError raised: Cannot transition quiz from DRAFT to CLOSED

purpose: Verify quiz archival transitions quiz to ARCHIVED status when permitted
preconditions: Quiz in CLOSED status with no pending grading
action_or_input: Request archive operation on closed quiz
expected_result: Quiz transitions to ARCHIVED state and is excluded from active listings

purpose: Verify adding a question to a quiz associates it with correct order and marks
preconditions: Draft quiz and Question record exist
expected_result: QuizQuestion record created with order=1 and marks=2.0

purpose: Verify capturing question text, options, and correct answer for MCQ question
action_or_input: Question.objects.create with question_text='What is 2+2?', options=['1','2','4'], correct_answer={'choice': '4'}
expected_result: Question created with question_text, options, and correct_answer correctly serialized

purpose: Verify question marks and difficulty level are captured and persisted
expected_result: Question stored with default_marks=5.0 and difficulty='HARD'

purpose: Verify negative marking value can be captured on a question
expected_result: Question persists negative_marks=0.5

purpose: Verify questions can be removed from draft quiz
action_or_input: Delete QuizQuestion entry for question 2 before quiz publication
expected_result: Question removed from quiz; quiz_questions count reduced to 1

purpose: Verify support for multiple question types: MCQ_SINGLE, MCQ_MULTI, TRUE_FALSE, SHORT_ANSWER
action_or_input: Create Question instances for all 4 choices of QuestionType
expected_result: All 4 question types successfully created and stored with valid question_type choices

purpose: Verify professor can store a question in QuestionBank for reuse
expected_result: Question associated with bank and retrievable via bank.questions.all()

purpose: Verify searching and filtering QuestionBank by difficulty and question type
preconditions: QuestionBank with questions of varying difficulty and types
action_or_input: Filter question bank query with difficulty='EASY' and question_type='MCQ_SINGLE'
expected_result: Query returns only EASY single-choice questions in that bank

purpose: Verify reusing an existing QuestionBank question in a new quiz
expected_result: New quiz created with Q_bank linked via QuizQuestion

purpose: Verify configuring custom duration limit for a quiz
expected_result: Quiz duration_minutes persisted as 90

purpose: Verify ordering of questions during presentation follows configured order
preconditions: Quiz with QuizQuestions having order=1, order=2, order=3
expected_result: Questions returned strictly in ascending sequence of order field

purpose: Verify back-navigation restriction prevents accessing previous question
preconditions: Quiz configured with allow_back_navigation=False; student on Question 2
action_or_input: Student attempts to save or view answer for Question 1
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request: Back-navigation is disabled for this quiz

purpose: Verify negative marking configuration is stored on quiz or question
expected_result: Negative marking enabled flag persisted

purpose: Verify toggling answer key release and grades release
expected_result: quiz.grades_released is updated to True in database

purpose: Verify tab blocking locks student attempt upon window blur or tab switch
preconditions: Active student attempt on quiz with tab_blocking_enabled=True
expected_result: Attempt locked or warning logged according to tab block policy

purpose: Verify student can view published and closed quizzes on student dashboard
preconditions: 1 Draft quiz, 1 Published quiz, 1 Closed quiz in database
expected_result: Returns published and closed quizzes; excludes draft quiz

purpose: Verify pre-start information displays title, duration, question count, and schedule
expected_result: Response contains title, duration_minutes, total_marks, start_time, end_time, and questions list

purpose: Verify student cannot start attempt before quiz start_time
preconditions: Quiz with start_time in future (now + 1 hour)
expected_result: ValueError raised: Quiz is not currently available for attempt

purpose: Verify student cannot start attempt after quiz end_time
preconditions: Quiz with end_time in past (now - 1 hour)
expected_result: ValueError raised: Quiz is not currently available for attempt

purpose: Verify student cannot start attempt on a DRAFT quiz
expected_result: ValueError raised: Quiz is not currently available for attempt

purpose: Verify student cannot start additional attempt when permitted attempt limit exhausted
preconditions: Quiz configured with permitted_attempts=1; student already submitted attempt 1
action_or_input: Student attempts to start attempt 2 on same quiz
expected_result: ValueError raised: Maximum permitted attempts reached for this quiz

purpose: Verify valid start_attempt creates in-progress attempt with started_at timestamp
preconditions: Published quiz with start_time < now < end_time
expected_result: QuizAttempt created with status='IN_PROGRESS', started_at set, and StudentAnswer slots created

purpose: Verify pre-start background application check is performed and reported
preconditions: Student preparing to start proctored attempt
expected_result: System performs environment/background process validation and prompts student if violations detected

purpose: Verify attempt presentation includes question answer slots for all quiz questions
preconditions: Attempt started for quiz with 3 questions
expected_result: Exactly 3 StudentAnswer records exist, each pointing to corresponding quiz question

purpose: Verify saving student answer for a question in active attempt
expected_result: StudentAnswer.submitted_answer updated to {'choice': 'B'}

purpose: Verify student answers persist across multiple calls during active attempt
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS status with saved answer for question 1
action_or_input: Save answer for question 2, then re-fetch answer for question 1 from database
expected_result: Previously saved answer for question 1 remains unchanged in database

purpose: Verify remaining time detection: is_attempt_expired returns False when within duration
preconditions: Attempt started 5 minutes ago with duration_minutes=30
expected_result: Returns False: Attempt is active

purpose: Verify remaining time detection: is_attempt_expired returns True when duration exceeded
preconditions: Attempt started 35 minutes ago with duration_minutes=30
expected_result: Returns True: Attempt is expired

purpose: Verify manual submission transitions attempt from IN_PROGRESS to submitted/evaluated
preconditions: Active in-progress attempt with saved answers
expected_result: Attempt submitted_at recorded, status transitions to EVALUATED

purpose: Verify manual submission confirmation reports unanswered questions count
preconditions: Attempt with 3 questions, only 1 question answered
action_or_input: Calculate unanswered question count before submission
expected_result: Unanswered question count equals 2

purpose: Verify submitted attempt is locked and cannot receive further answer modifications
expected_result: ValueError raised: Attempt is closed

purpose: Verify save_answer triggers auto-submit when attempt has expired
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS, but time expired (now > started_at + duration)
expected_result: ValueError raised: Time expired, and attempt is auto-submitted

purpose: Verify submission triggers autograding evaluation for objective questions
preconditions: Attempt with single-choice question having correct answer 'A', student answered 'A'
expected_result: StudentAnswer autograded_score set to question marks and attempt total_score updated

purpose: Verify scoring correct MCQ_SINGLE question
expected_result: Returns Decimal('2.0')

purpose: Verify scoring incorrect MCQ_SINGLE question without negative marking
expected_result: Returns Decimal('0.0')

purpose: Verify scoring MCQ_MULTI question with exact set match
expected_result: Returns Decimal('3.0')

purpose: Verify scoring TRUE_FALSE question matching boolean/value
preconditions: Question TRUE_FALSE with correct_answer={'value': True}, default_marks=1.0
expected_result: Returns Decimal('1.0')

purpose: Verify scoring SHORT_ANSWER question matching model answer substring
expected_result: Returns Decimal('2.5')

purpose: Verify negative marking deduction on wrong answer when negative marking enabled
preconditions: Question with default_marks=2.0, negative_marks=0.5; wrong answer submitted
expected_result: Returns Decimal('-0.5'): score deducted according to configured negative marks

purpose: Verify aggregate result computes percentage and pass/fail status against passing marks
action_or_input: Submit attempt and check computed is_passed and percentage
expected_result: Attempt record indicates percentage=35.0% and is_passed=False

purpose: Verify storing reference answer and evaluation criteria for subjective question
action_or_input: Question.objects.create with question_type='SHORT_ANSWER', correct_answer={'model_answer': 'Full reference text', 'criteria': 'Keywords A, B'}
expected_result: Reference answer and criteria stored in correct_answer JSON

purpose: Verify invoking AI evaluation component for subjective answer
action_or_input: Trigger AI-assisted evaluation API endpoint for attempt answer
expected_result: AI evaluation component receives answer and returns evaluation feedback payload

purpose: Verify AI suggested score is advisory and does not automatically become final score
preconditions: AI suggests score of 4.0 out of 5.0 for subjective answer
action_or_input: Check final_score before professor manual confirmation
expected_result: Answer final score remains unconfirmed/pending until professor approves

purpose: Verify professor can override score and provide feedback for subjective response
expected_result: StudentAnswer updated with override_score=4.5, feedback='Well argued', and attempt total_score updated

purpose: Verify maintaining result record with total score and submission timestamp
expected_result: total_score is non-null and submitted_at is recorded

purpose: Verify professor can release quiz results to students
expected_result: Quiz grades_released updated to True

purpose: Verify student can view results when quiz grades are released
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK: Response includes total_score and evaluated answers

purpose: Verify student cannot view detailed results when grades have not been released
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Grades for this quiz have not yet been released

purpose: Verify professor can view all student submissions for associated quiz
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK: List of 2 attempts returned for grading/monitoring

purpose: Verify logging integrity event during quiz attempt
expected_result: AttemptIntegrityLog created with event_type='FULLSCREEN_EXIT', timestamp, and details
